apps.name: Otraku
apps.subtitle: AniList client
apps.localizedDescription: Otraku is an unofficial AniList client for Android and iOS built with Flutter. Browse, search and update your anime and manga lists with a polished native interface.
apps.versionDescription:
Otraku 1.13.1 | Otraku-v.1.13.1-ios17+

- Added localizations support.
- Added Turkish localization (thanks @kyoyacchi).
- Unfinished messages are persisted in storage, so mistakenly closing the sheet won't cause you to loose your progress (thanks @0-BlackSpectrum-0).
- Added progress and repeats info to the following tab in the media page. (thanks @0-BlackSpectrum-0).
- Added "Watchable On"/"Readable On" filter in discover filters for anime/manga.
- Added support for underline formatting.
- Added support for the "Same Universe" media relation.
- Made all markdown content selectable: activities, replies, threads, comments, user/character/staff bios, reviews and media descriptions.
- Expanded images now have a menu with buttons to download the image or share it (thanks @0-BlackSpectrum-0).
- The copy button in the link sheet was replaced by a share button.
- Fixed the last item in the collection list sheet being cut off.
- Fixed incorrect marker clipping of unread notifications (thanks @0-BlackSpectrum-0).
- Fixed markdown not being rendered in list notes.
- Fixed the back button briefly appearing on some tabs of the home page.
